title: wlw-tag-team-wlw-worldleague-2003
label: Brett Young and The Suicide Kid

won.source: The promotion's own administration declares Brett Young and The Suicide Kid champions after the belts vanish from a ringside casket during the three-fall gauntlet's ladder-match final fall; the following update bulletin confirms the ruling.

note: An ad hoc pairing of one wrestler from each of the two teams left in the ladder-match final fall, not a pre-existing team.

end.source: Mr. Excitement Dropkick grabs both new belts in the 9 October 2002 steel cage ladder match while paired with the opposing team's Wasted Youth; the promotion's own administration declares them co-champions instead.

title: wlw-tag-team-wlw-worldleague-2003
label: Mr. Excitement Dropkick and Wasted Youth

won.source: Dropkick grabs both newly-commissioned belts in a steel cage ladder match while paired with Wasted Youth of the opposing team; the promotion's own administration declares them champions.

end.source: A fatal four-way elimination match reunites Dropkick with his own partner Brett Young, who together become the clean, undisputed champions.

note: A second ad hoc pairing of one wrestler from each of two rival teams, immediately disputed by Blind Reflection's own theft of the belts moments after they were awarded.

won.source: Dropkick and Brett Young, reunited as The American Dreams, win a fatal four-way elimination match against The Dieties outright.

end.source: The Goodfellas win the titles at Wrestlebowl V with the WLW Tag Team President's own interference.

title: wlw-tag-team-wlw-worldleague-2003
label: The Goodfellas

won.source: The Goodfellas win a no-disqualification match against The American Dreams at Wrestlebowl V with the WLW Tag Team President's own interference.

note: Immediately challenged in the ring afterward by Nick and Devin Demola ("The Resurrection"), an angle rather than a title match.

title: wlw-championship-wlw-worldleague-2003
label: Will Geddings

won.source: The promotion's own 25 October 2002 press conference states Geddings won the WLW Championship in a 43-minute Quadruple Threat match on 22 October 2002; the broadcast of that match's own second hour does not survive in this wing's own held record.

note: Retains the title at Wrestlebowl V, 13 December 2002, defeating Brody Thunder in a Chicago street fight with a small package. The event link is this wing's own 22 October 2002 show record; that show's own held text is Hour 1 only, and does not itself contain the title-deciding match (see the show's own date note).

won.source: Slayne pins K.C. Hagen, Eric Cooper and Carl Lumski simultaneously with a top-rope splash at Wrestlebowl V.

title: wrestlebowl-wlw-worldleague-2003
label: Corey Irons

won.source: Irons pins defending champion Joshua Barnes at Wrestlebowl V after The J'ster tangles Barnes' leg in his own cane.

note: The title itself predates this promotion; only its fifth edition, hosted by the WLW, is attested in this wing's own held record.
